title: SYNK PATH · 첫 면접실
scope: Quest-targeted seated interview combining four Seedance 720p clips with local 4K enlargement, nine long-edge-3840 static room assets, local speech recognition and fixed room photo surfaces. Original 480p pilot, 3D prototype and comparison samples retained separately. No real company scan; revised headset comfort, performance and human listening validation pending.

questRoom.interviewerAudio: Native generated audio in the new 720p Seedance 2.5 clips, copied into the local 4K enlargements; not the legacy Supertonic voices below. Listening playback is muted.
questRoom.surfaces: Nine long-edge-3840 JPEG assets retain the existing room registration. The pre-start poster is frame zero of the actual default 4K question video and uses the video background blend; the registration reference remains separate. Left/right wall photographs use fixed physical wall UVs; ceiling uses the wide front plate with fixed plane UVs. Floor and desk use dedicated crops from their original plates; rear wall uses an orthographic elevation. The 1.7-metre-deep tabletop and fragment-level video reprojection are retained. Assets are Lanczos enlargements, not native-4K photography or AI detail reconstruction.

surfaceProduction.method: Existing pixels only: optional UV crop or video first-frame extraction, local FFmpeg Lanczos enlargement and JPEG encoding.
surfaceProduction.rightsScope: Derived from the retained generated room photographs and Seedance footage; not covered by legacy CC0 or MIT asset licenses. Individual source/output paths, dimensions and hashes are in the production record.

comfortRevision.userReport: The user reported severe discomfort in both desktop look-around and headset use.
comfortRevision.desktop: Default 30-degree button and arrow-key turns, front reset, opt-in low-sensitivity drag with pitch limits and no inertia, inside a stable outer frame.
comfortRevision.headset: Initial room anchor uses the first valid viewer pose at the centre of both eyes. Physical head tracking stays 1:1. Static textures are uploaded in stages before entry.
comfortRevision.limits: Code and desktop checks do not establish headset frame rate, improved motion comfort, presence or visual seamlessness. Those require renewed physical-headset and user checks.

videoProduction.costScope: Four completed jobs submitted once at the approved 70-credit quote; shared-account balance changes are not attributed as the job cost.
videoProduction.rightsScope: Provider-generated fictional people and native audio; not covered by the legacy 3D assets MIT or CC0 licenses. Media paths, hashes and both quality variants are in the current manifest.

frontRoomExtensions.rightsScope: Generated assets; not covered by the Poly Haven CC0 or Rocketbox MIT asset licenses.

rearWallPhoto.rightsScope: Generated asset; not covered by the Poly Haven CC0 or Rocketbox MIT asset licenses.

questRoom.limits: People remain mono video generated at 720p and optionally enlarged to 4K, with no translated-view parallax or synthesized side view. Two prepared follow-ups are selected by keyword rules, not unrestricted AI conversation or hiring assessment. Room scenery is a seated prototype, not a reconstruction of a real building. Headset presence, performance, real microphone recognition and full human listening are unverified.
